title.es: Guía para Sala de Conferencias con Pantalla Dual

description.en: I want to use only the left screen
description.es: Quiero usar solo la pantalla izquierda

description.en: I want to use only the right screen
description.es: Quiero usar solo la pantalla derecha

description.en: I want to use both screens simultaneously

instruction.en: Locate the Left Screen Console. It should look something like this:
instruction.es: Localice la consola de la pantalla izquierda. Debería verse algo así:

alt.en: Left Screen Console

instruction.en: Let's start from scratch, try to reset the console to start from the home screen
instruction.es: Comencemos desde cero, intente restablecer la consola para comenzar desde la pantalla de inicio

alt.en: Video showing how to exit out of device mode and return to HOME
alt.es: Video que muestra cómo salir del modo dispositivo y regresar a HOME

instruction.en: Next, let's 'seperate' the room. On the small audio panel, make sure that the Room Combine button likes like this. If it doesn't, give it a click
instruction.es: A continuación, vamos a 'separar' la sala. En el panel de audio pequeño, asegúrese de que el botón de Combinación de Sala (Room Combine) se vea así. Si no es así, hágale clic

alt.en: Shows the button for Rooms Combine on the Main Console
alt.es: Muestra el botón para el Rooms Combine en la Consola Principal

instruction.en: Select the input 'Poly Classroom 1'

alt.en: Poly 1 input solected turned on

instruction.en: Next, let's go to the Main Console. Click the 'Device Mode' button

alt.en: Activate Device mode

instruction.en: Next, let's go to the Main Console. Click the 'Device Mode' button

alt.en: Activate Device mode

instruction.en: Next, let's go to the Main Console. Click the 'Device Mode' button
instruction.es: ¡Haga clic en 'Otro usuario' en la parte inferior izquierda e inicie sesión en su perfil!

alt.en: Activate Device mode

instruction.en: Once 'Device Mode' is active, the screen should look like this:

alt.en: Shows end result for activating device mode

instruction.en: Now let's turn our attention to the left screen. If it is off, you can turn it on using the power button:

alt.en: Shows where to find the TV power button

instruction.en: Let's select the correct TV input. Press the Home button on the TV

alt.en: Shows where to find the TV home button

instruction.en: Press the PC option on the screen

alt.en: Shows where to press the PC option on the TV screen

instruction.en: Select the 'HDMI 1' option on the screen

alt.en: Shows where to press the HDMI 1 option on the TV screen

instruction.en: This should then bring up the main computer screen. If it is small, you can maximize the window by pressing 'Maximaize' here:

alt.en: Shows where to maximize the main Windows screen

instruction.en: Now, locate the left side keyboard. It is labeled 'QNS-CLASSROOM1' and looks like this:

alt.en: Displays an image of keyboard labeled QNS-CLASSROOM1

instruction.en: Make sure the keyboard is turned on. The switch on top of the keyboard should be set to the green color

alt.en: Displays an ON setting for the power switch on the keyboard labeled QNS-CLASSROOM2

instruction.en: This should then bring up the main computer screen. If it is small, you can maximize the window by pressing 'Maximaize' here:

alt.en: Shows where to maximize the main Windows screen

instruction.en: Try moving the mouse pad or click on keys on the keyboard. Now click on 'Other User' on the bottom left and sign into your profile!
instruction.es: Intente mover el mouse o presione teclas en el teclado. ¡Ahora haga clic en 'Otro usuario' en la parte inferior izquierda e inicie sesión en su perfil!

alt.en: Pic displaying the 'Other Users' log in screen on the Main TV
alt.es: Imagen que muestra la pantalla de inicio de sesión de 'Otros usuarios' en la TV principal

instruction.es: Localice la consola de la pantalla derecha. Debería verse algo así:

instruction.en: Turn on the right screen using the power button
instruction.es: Encienda la pantalla derecha usando el botón de encendido

alt.en: Right screen turned on

instruction.en: Click on 'Other User' on the bottom left and sign into your profile!
instruction.es: ¡Haga clic en 'Otro usuario' en la parte inferior izquierda e inicie sesión en su perfil!

alt.en: Log in screen on the right screen
alt.es: Pantalla de inicio de sesión en la pantalla derecha
